card.fact_statement: Red Dot United (RDU) participated in the 2025 Singaporean general election.
card.source_span: In October 2023, the Singapore People's Party (SPP), National Solidarity Party (NSP), Red Dot United (RDU), and SUP announced a "non-formal partnership"

target_qa_variants.question: Ni chama kipi cha kisiasa kilichoorodheshwa pamoja na Singapore People's Party, National Solidarity Party, na SUP katika ushirikiano usio rasmi wa mwaka 2023 kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: In October 2023, the Singapore People's Party (SPP), National Solidarity Party (NSP), Red Dot United (RDU), and SUP announced a "non-formal partnership"
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Proper nouns for foreign political parties are kept in English as is standard in Swahili.

backtranslation_en.question: Which political party was listed together with the Singapore People's Party, National Solidarity Party, and SUP in an informal 2023 alliance before the 2025 election?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Swahili translation accurately preserves the fact, entities, and intent of the source question without adding new constraints.
